description: Record your verdict for EVERY pattern group of a failure analysis, in ONE call, after reading the evidence of all of them (page unseen groups with failure_analysis({ analysisId, pattern: [...] }) first — a group whose evidence was never shown is rejected) and reviewing every failed test case with failure_analysis({ analysisId, review: true }). Use `splitOut` for test cases whose review shows a different cause and `mergeInto` for groups that share a root cause. An incomplete review is accepted; the card then says how many test cases were reviewed. The MCP applies merges / splits, recomputes counts and %, and returns the classified card: start your reply with it exactly as returned. Calling again overwrites a group's verdict. Changes only this MCP's memory — nothing is written to SimplifyQA. Categories (exactly three): APP_DEFECT (Application Failures) — the application does something wrong with an unchanged test and unchanged data, or the application / a service is down or unreachable (HTTP 404/5xx page, subtype "environment"). AUTOMATION_DATA (Automation Script / Test Data Failures) — script, locator, timing/synchronisation, test data, configuration, device, a manual stop, or the application changed on purpose (screen, label, flow, rule, expected value) so the test is outdated (subtype "intended change"). UNCLASSIFIED (Unclassified / Investigation Required) — the evidence does not decide it; rootCause is then the reason / the missing evidence. "Element not found" with no other evidence is UNCLASSIFIED.

domain.description: The application domain you stated from the application profile: { name, confidence (high | medium | low), flows[] (<=12), terms {term: meaning}, assumptions? }. Remembered for this project.

verdicts.description: One entry per pattern group: { group (the number, or the label the card shows, e.g. "3b"), pattern (short name), rootCause (one or two sentences, from the evidence), category (APP_DEFECT = Application Failures | AUTOMATION_DATA = Automation Script / Test Data Failures | UNCLASSIFIED = Investigation Required, then rootCause is the reason / missing evidence), confidence (high | medium | low), subtype? (short free text: environment, intended change, locator, test data), recommendedAction? (what to do), mergeInto? (same pattern as that group), splitOut? (iteration keys "<executionId>:<runId>" that do not belong here → their own group) }.

name: failure_analysis_classify
title: Record verdicts for a failure analysis
